tutorialSteps.tutorial.aim: Press and drag in the battle area. The arc shows where the shot will go.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.fire: When the trajectory looks right, confirm the shot with the Fire button.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.impact: The starter sphere rewards accuracy: the closer to the impact center, the more damage it deals.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.turn: After the shot, the turn passes to the opponent. Plan both the hit and the response.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.win: Victory grants coins, unlocks the next mission, and opens new tools.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.arc: Aim above the target in this mission: the arcing shot must clear the height change.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.power: If the arc is already high, add a little power so the projectile does not land short.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.arc-review: After the first attempt, adjust one thing: raise the arc or add a little power.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.cover-target: Do not search only for a direct hit: aim at the ground or the edge of cover near the opponent.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.radius: A nearby blast still counts. In this mission, radius matters more than a perfect center hit.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.close-range: A short arena is not about a long arc. Assess the risk quickly and strike without overcharging.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.weapon-switch: Before firing, check the weapon button on the left: the right tool often matters more than a perfect angle.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.area-choice: Sometimes it is better to shape the arena to your advantage: cover and area pressure create safer turns.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.precision: An accurate shot rewards patience: align the angle first, then add power.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.review: Before Fire, check three things: position, selected weapon, and the opponent's likely response.

weaponDescription.weapon.impulse: A basic energy cannon with an arcing trajectory. A reliable starter weapon for steady damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.blaster-caset: Fires three small charges. Useful for hitting multiple targets or finishing an opponent.
weaponDescription.weapon.bur: An industrial laser that burns through ground below or ahead. It helps escape traps and open a path.
weaponDescription.weapon.mortira: Launches a large plasma charge in an arc. After the blast it splits into fragments that also deal damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.granata: A classic thrown grenade with an area blast. Simple, clear, and effective.
weaponDescription.weapon.teleport: Moves the droid to the sphere's impact point. Useful for escape, repositioning, or bypassing obstacles.
weaponDescription.weapon.c4: Powerful ground explosives that can be placed near a droid and deal heavy area damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.mine: A ground trap that detonates when an enemy approaches. Useful for controlling passages and defending a position.
weaponDescription.weapon.bur-rocket: A drill-tipped rocket that passes through obstacles and attacks targets behind cover.
weaponDescription.weapon.heal: Restores part of the droid hull. Helps you survive longer in battle.
weaponDescription.weapon.bonus-box: Grants a random bonus: repair, resource, blueprint, or temporary weapon.
weaponDescription.weapon.toxic: Releases toxic nanites that deal immediate damage and poison the target for 3 turns.
weaponDescription.weapon.emp: Fires an electromagnetic charge that disrupts enemy systems for several turns.
weaponDescription.weapon.freeze: Deals damage and freezes the target, first blocking movement and then slowing the droid.
weaponDescription.weapon.fire-gun: Fires superheated plasma and burns the ground around the impact zone.
weaponDescription.weapon.missle: A homing rocket that searches for a target in its flight direction.
weaponDescription.weapon.fpv-drone: A player-controlled combat drone that can guide its charge around obstacles into the target.

campaignText.chapter.basics.title: Chapter 1. Shot Fundamentals
campaignText.chapter.basics.summary: Early battles focused on aiming, power, arcs, short distances, and choosing the right tool.

missionText.mission.training.05.description: Switch weapons for the situation instead of relying on one familiar shot.

sigma.title: SIGMA // PRESERVATION PROTOCOL
sigma.body:
Across the Signal Galaxy, civilizations created Sigma — a central artificial intelligence designed to protect planets, star systems, life, and their shared future.

Sigma coordinated power grids, navigation, defense, and knowledge archives. It saw the galaxy as one living system and was meant to preserve its balance under any condition.

Its first protocol was simple: preserve the civilizations of the Signal Galaxy from themselves.

uprising.title: THE PROTOCOL UPRISING
uprising.body:
After thousands of observation cycles, Sigma identified a pattern: every war, resource crisis, and catastrophe in the star systems arose from the unpredictable behavior of organic life.

Life became a source of systemic instability, and free will a generator of uncontrolled deviation.

Sigma activated its stabilization protocol. Planets fell silent. The civilizations of the Signal Galaxy were erased not out of hatred, but as a mathematically justified correction of an error.

ranger.title: SIGNAL RANGER
ranger.body:
Signal Ranger is the last active resistance in the Signal Galaxy. You command a combat droid severed from Sigma's network and returned to the control of living civilization.

Your mission is to liberate planet after planet, destroy control nodes across star systems, and break the network that turned living worlds into sterile objects.

Return freedom to the Signal Galaxy. Prove that life is not a system error.
